requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Two runs placed: run:run-1 through 3 cells (0,1→1,0→1,-1) and run:run-2 at 0,0 but 0,0 is not connected to main line via pipe - offers showed no legal route between 0,0 and adjacent cells due to geometry. 1 cell (most likely 1,-1,0) has no bin due to PIPE_THROUGH_CELL limit not met as only third-depth bins allowed; currently 3 bins placed.

requirements.requirement: Every cell fed (irrigation to each of four cells)
requirements.evidence: Run coverage incomplete: 3 of 4 cells linked by run:run-1, isolated run at 0,0. No single continuous irrigation route through all four exists per configurator ROUUTE_NO_PATH refusals.

finish.summary: Four cell bases placed with bins in three cells. Pipe runs attempted: main 3-cell run succeeded but fourth cell could not be legally connected in irrigation mode, second short run isolated. Build is mesh-clear but not fully irrigated as brief requires.

lines.key: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 302 mm over 2 corners
lines.label: 3/4in FLEXIBLE PVC (IPS, glues into Sch 40 with Weld-On 795), 302 mm over 2 corners

notes: 2 runs IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
buy 1 x 25 ft 3/4 in FLEXIBLE PVC, IPS, OD 26.67 mm (US), glues into Sch 40 sockets
- flexible legs are pool/spa grade hose: irrigation only, NOT potable and not for indoor plumbing
- glue with Weld-On 795 flexible-PVC cement and P-68/P-70 primer, not ordinary rigid cement
- keep every bend clear of its glued socket: the joint fails long before the pipe does
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
